lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Ash Camp got their weapons. My crews. Except they weren't my crews, they were forty years before me, and I was a kid hearing about it.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Here's the thing. I remember it both ways. I remember the wall coming down and I remember it holding, both, at once, right now, sitting here. Wren says that's what Continuity feels like when it slips. Wren says a lot of things calmly.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: We walked away from it. Fine. I've walked away from worse and I'll do it again.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: That sentry over the square is new, though. That wasn't there. I'm going to wreck it one of these nights and I'm telling you now so you can't say you were surprised.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Wardens. Humans. In armour, taking Board pay, to put down other humans. That's what did it. Not drones — drones cost money and we weren't worth the money.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: So now you've seen it. Tell me again why the machines are the part we're being careful with.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Level with me. Do you think the thing in that core is alive.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Don't answer fast. Because if it's yes, you and me have got a problem coming, and I'd rather have it now over a fire than later over a decision.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Good. You get it. Every model burns. Including the good ones.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Especially the good ones. The bad ones fall over on their own.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Drones on the perimeter again. Go break some if you want the practice. Thermal goes straight through the shields, and Wreck takes the shield off entirely, so pick one and commit.
